name: runner-adapter-resolves-existing-repo
description: Incident 2026-11-11 bootstrap #5 (ADR 0260, amended by ADR 0370): the first runner adapter (runner-orca, since deleted) registered its own clone next to the owner's checkout and unregistered it after every job, so one project showed two source repos and churned a new repo id per job. A runner adapter must resolve the checkout the machine already has for the job's repo by canonical identity and make the job's worktree there; per-job state is a worktree and a run branch, never a checkout or its registration.
message: Resolve the job's checkout by canonical remote identity (runner-local's findCheckout) before falling back to the host's clone, and never remove or unregister a checkout in prepareWorkspace or release. See .factory/checks/runner-adapters.md and ADR 0260.
